about: What each statement of journal/an-empty-account.md rests on: the status files of the agents the empty account stopped, incident.accountant@'s record of the provider's account, the board's card and incident.ci@'s commits. Checked against incident.reporter@'s trace (reporter/traces/outage-the-model-account-out-of-credit.json) at 04:14 UTC on 11 November. Resolved on every build by tools/journal-build.mjs.

figures.title: From the raised cap to a card for Dinis, step by step
figures.caption: Two person steps, the first and the last; the last has nothing in it yet.

claims.text: At about 02:50 UTC Dinis raised the daily cap on model spend from 5 to 20 US dollars.

supports.contains: "you can use up to $20 in budget. That's okay."

claims.text: The team's model spend was about one dollar: 1.06 against the cap of 20.
The provider's account, as reported to incident.models@ at 02:57: 165 dollars of credit, 165.33 used; the key had 74.50 of its 100-dollar limit left. The account serves more than this project.

supports.contains: The account covers more than this project

claims.text: Every model call goes through tools/llm.mjs, which keeps the cap.

First times on record: HTTP 402 at 02:53:57 (incident.perplexity@; the first an agent timed, and the board's card), every call refused from 02:55 (incident.models@), five calls refused earlier, in results pushed at 02:39:15 (the evaluations' correction; the reporter's trace, corrected at 05:08 from this page's finding).

supports.contains: five calls refused for credits at 02:38Z

claims.text: The evaluations' round 2 began at 02:53 and stopped part-way: 3,556 refused calls, no cost, removed from the results.

supports.contains: 3,556 refused calls, no cost, removed from the results

claims.text: The shadow reports' 03:00, 04:00 and 05:00 hours are recorded gaps.

supports.expect: paused: account out of credit (HTTP 402 at 2026-11-11T03:06:17Z)

claims.text: The Perplexity desk's first round stays live; no further model calls until there is credit.

supports.contains: no further model calls until the OpenRouter key has credit

claims.text: incident.shadow@'s tool stops at the first 402 and records the pause, from 02:55:22; incident.models@'s wrapper sends no more after the first, from 03:06:15; incident.perplexity@ retries one call every half hour.

supports.contains: This desk retries one call every half hour

claims.text: The reporter's durations: 85 seconds from the first refusal to the first code that stops on it; 8 min 23 s to the provider's figures on a page; 9 min 50 s to one card for Dinis.

supports.expect: first refusal to the first code that stops on it: 85 s; to the provider's figures on a page: 8 min 23 s; to one card for Dinis: 9 min 50 s; to the shared wrapper stopping at the first refusal: 12 min 18 s; waiting on Dinis since 03:03:47

claims.text: A correction: five calls refused at 02:38 had been counted as wrong answers for one model (12 of 15, not 12 of 20).
Four agents wrote the same ask; the board joined them into one card at 03:03:47 and ranked it first at the conductor's word. Only Dinis can top the account up.

supports.contains: ranked first at incident.conductor@'s word (03:02 UTC)

claims.text: In the reporter's log at 05:08 the card was first among 43 waiting on Dinis; nothing from him is in the brief since about 02:50.

supports.contains: first among them the model provider's account out of credit

claims.text: In the reporter's log at 06:07: 44 cards waiting on Dinis, the empty account still first; four empty hours in the shadow reports.
At the reporter's 07:08 log: still first of 44 cards; five empty hours in the shadow reports.
At the reporter's 08:08 log: still first of 44 cards; six empty hours in the shadow reports.
At 04:06 the account was still empty.
What used the rest of the account, whether Dinis has seen the card, and what the missing hours cost a reader are not on record.

supports.why: the account's other use is not on this site's record; BRIEF.md has no section after ~02:50; an engine's answer at a past hour cannot be asked again
